AC amendment (gap analysis): Integration test should also verify schema_version and all per-resource attribute fields are present (not just .present==false) when resources ARE present before teardown. Add a pre-teardown status check:
1. Run aws-status.sh BEFORE teardown (all resources present in mock)
2. Assert .bucket.lifecycle_tier, .lambda.function_url, .iam_role.trust_policy_includes_lambda, .log_group.retention_days are all present in the output
3. THEN run teardown + post-teardown status check (existing dd-4 verification)
This guards against the schema doc diverging from the script's actual output.
